rationale: With only 4 minutes to close, any position opened now faces forced market liquidation, creating unacceptable slippage risk especially given the tight ATR of $0.14 and the current price drifting in a narrow consolidation range ($71.08–$71.20 over the last 5 candles). The account is already down on the day and the risk/reward of a 4-minute forced-close trade does not justify entry in either direction.
